controls.evidence: Clearstar cbAssets Vault (CSCBUSDC) at base:0x91c056b6d4311a743614fbc03ac32d4e6a2d3a3c is the current public ERC-4626 VaultV2 share over USDC 0x833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913. Deposits transfer underlying before minting; interest accrual can mint configured fee shares and recognizes adapter losses. Holder rights are residual proportional code-enforced NAV redemption, not beneficial ownership of Circle reserves or proven statutory segregation. One current adapter 0x812b71c33ae5eafebae967c5670e37eca3cab0ac holds 8 enumerated Morpho market IDs. Performance fee 10% of gains, management fee 0%; fee-share accrual is not discretionary minting of underlying USDC. EIP-1967 implementation, admin and beacon slots were zero.

review.evidence: Clearstar cbAssets Vault (CSCBUSDC) at base:0x91c056b6d4311a743614fbc03ac32d4e6a2d3a3c is the current public ERC-4626 VaultV2 share over USDC 0x833589fcd6edb6e08f4c7c32d4f71b54bda02913. Deposits transfer underlying before minting; interest accrual can mint configured fee shares and recognizes adapter losses. Holder rights are residual proportional code-enforced NAV redemption, not beneficial ownership of Circle reserves or proven statutory segregation. One current adapter 0x812b71c33ae5eafebae967c5670e37eca3cab0ac holds 8 enumerated Morpho market IDs. At base block 52095852 (0x31aeb6c), observed 2026-10-02T22:44:15.795793+00:00, receiveSharesGate, sendSharesGate and receiveAssetsGate were zero and all three setters were abdicated. Reviewed VaultV2 transfer/transferFrom and withdraw/redeem use these gates. sendAssetsGate was zero with its setter not abdicated; it governs deposit/mint, not direct withdrawal or transfer. Deposit-dependent in-kind paths can be constrained by it. USDC freeze exposure is inherited from usdc-circle; this is not a direct share blacklist claim. Local fee/curator authority is not USDC issuer supervision or reserve-liability reconciliation.
